lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: My best friend is a chicken. His name is Greg.

lines.speaker: skeptic
lines.text: You named a chicken Greg?

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: He named himself. I just respected his choice.

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: Threw a party. Nobody came. The cake rotted.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.text: That's depressing.

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: I ate it anyway. 5/10, would grief again.

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: Spent 6 hours building a friendship with someone.

lines.speaker: skeptic
lines.text: That's nice.

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: We're both scheduled to leave tomorrow. I want a refund.

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: Fine day to stand around looking industrious.

lines.speaker: neighbor
lines.text: Holding a wooden plank makes anyone look busy.

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: I've held this same plank since dawn.

lines.speaker: elder
lines.text: The valley is quiet today. Almost too quiet.

lines.speaker: youth
lines.text: Isn't quiet what we wanted when we settled here?

lines.speaker: elder
lines.text: Quiet usually means the wolves are planning something.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: The harvest bins are groaning under the weight.

lines.speaker: trader
lines.text: Good roads mean we can actually haul it to market.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: Just make sure the goats don't eat the wagon wheels.

lines.speaker: parent
lines.text: The children found a hornet nest by the well.

lines.speaker: neighbor
lines.text: Did they run away?

lines.speaker: parent
lines.text: They named the queen and tried to feed her berries.

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: Heard howling past the timber line last night.

lines.speaker: neighbor
lines.text: The gate bars are latched tight.

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: Good. I don't feel like sharing my stew.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Look what I found in the hollow log!

lines.speaker: parent
lines.text: Please tell me it doesn't have more than four legs.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: It has no legs and it smells like ancient moss!

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: I bet I can jump across the entire garden ditch!

lines.speaker: sibling
lines.text: The mud is two feet deep.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Then you better catch my boots when I fly!

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: Can I help chop down the big pine tree?

lines.speaker: parent
lines.text: You can barely lift the wooden spoon.

lines.speaker: child
lines.text: I will defeat the tree with sheer enthusiasm!

lines.speaker: pupil
lines.text: Why do we need numbers if the storage crate holds everything?

lines.speaker: teacher
lines.text: Because someone has to count when the grain runs out.

lines.speaker: pupil
lines.text: Then I would prefer to remain blissfully uneducated.

lines.speaker: pupil
lines.text: Is recess right after long division?

lines.speaker: friend
lines.text: Not if the teacher catches you drawing maps on your slate.

lines.speaker: pupil
lines.text: This isn't a map, it's a tactical escape route.

lines.speaker: suitor
lines.text: Walk with me toward the orchard?

lines.speaker: beloved
lines.text: Gladly. The blossoms are opening tonight.

lines.speaker: suitor
lines.text: The moon makes the valley look completely peaceful.

lines.speaker: suitor
lines.text: You're drawing water early today.

lines.speaker: beloved
lines.text: I had a feeling someone would offer to carry the bucket.

lines.speaker: suitor
lines.text: Your intuition is remarkably accurate.

lines.speaker: suitor
lines.text: Lovely evening for a stroll past the palisade.

lines.speaker: beloved
lines.text: It became lovely the moment you showed up.

lines.speaker: suitor
lines.text: I'll try to show up more often.

lines.speaker: visitor
lines.text: Greetings! Word of your settlement reached the coast.

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: We have dry timber and fresh iron if you bring salt.

lines.speaker: visitor
lines.text: Your traders strike a hard bargain, but a fair one.

lines.speaker: rival
lines.text: Mind where your foragers wander along the ridge.

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: The berry bushes grow on open valley soil.

lines.speaker: rival
lines.text: We remember every bushel you take across the river.

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: You keep saying you don't care, but you repaired my roof.

lines.speaker: skeptic
lines.text: I repaired the roof because replacing you would take longer.

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: Then why did you leave your coat on my chair?

lines.speaker: skeptic
lines.text: Because you were shivering. Don't make it a confession.

lines.speaker: settler
lines.text: I won't. But tomorrow, if you disappear, I'm coming after you.

lines.speaker: skeptic
lines.text: That's the problem. I know you mean it.

lines.speaker: gossip
lines.text: People say you have been meeting someone behind the mill.

lines.speaker: recluse
lines.text: People say many things because silence makes them nervous.

lines.speaker: gossip
lines.text: So you deny it?

lines.speaker: recluse
lines.text: I deny that the old mill is behind anything. It is beside the river.

lines.speaker: gossip
lines.text: That is not the denial I asked for.

lines.speaker: recluse
lines.text: Then ask a question you are prepared to hear answered.

lines.speaker: neighbor
lines.text: A crow stole my leather glove right off the fence post.

lines.speaker: skeptic
lines.text: Did you chase it down?

lines.speaker: neighbor
lines.text: No. It wore it with surprising elegance.
